scripts.build: yarn workspace chat build && yarn workspace extension build

chatConfig.provider.description: The provider to use for chat functionality (e.g., OpenAI, HuggingFace, etc.)

chatConfig.model.description: The model to use for chat operations (e.g., gpt-3.5-turbo, llama-2, etc.)

chatConfig.endpoint.description: The API endpoint URL for the chat provider.

chatConfig.apiKey.description: API key to authenticate requests with the chat provider.

chatConfig.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in a single chat response.

chatConfig.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for controlling the randomness of responses in chat.

autoCompleteConfig.provider.description: The provider for code autocompletion features.

autoCompleteConfig.model.description: Model ID to be used for autocompletion (e.g., gpt-3.5, codex, etc.).

autoCompleteConfig.endpoint.description: The API endpoint for the autocompletion provider.

autoCompleteConfig.apiKey.description: API key for autocompletion provider authentication.

autoCompleteConfig.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in autocomplete responses.

autoCompleteConfig.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for code autocomplete generation.

autoCompleteConfig.autocompleteDeleay.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering code autocompletion.

agentConfig.provider.description: The provider for the code agent feature.

agentConfig.model.description: Model ID to be used by the agent for code tasks.

agentConfig.endpoint.description: Endpoint for the agent API or service.

agentConfig.apiKey.description: API key to authenticate agent operations.

agentConfig.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in a single agent result or step.
